articles.title: Galaxy enters institutional prediction markets with $10 million Arca trade
articles.snippet: The digital asset firm launched OTC prediction markets trading for institutions and completed a $10 million trade tied to U.S. crypto legislation with hedge fund Arca.

articles.title: Here's how one decentralized cloud provider says private citizens can make money from AI
articles.snippet: Titan Network says its crowdsourced computing network has signed tech giants like Tencent and Alibaba as clients, saving them as much 75% on AI costs.

articles.title: CFTC chair claims Gemini case was politically motivated, seeks to reverse $5M settlement
articles.snippet: The CFTC chair seeks to roll back an enforcement action on the company founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss, donors to Donald Trump’s 2024 campaign and attendees at White House events.

articles.title: Zama accelerates compliance after court lifts $12.5M USDC freeze
articles.snippet: Privacy protocol Zama says it will accelerate compliance measures after a court lifted a $12.5 million USDC freeze tied to an unrelated legal dispute.

articles.title: HIVE Bitcoin holdings drop by 331 BTC in Q1, reports record $298M revenue
articles.snippet: HIVE reduced its Bitcoin holdings to 150 BTC while annual revenue climbed to $297.8 million, driven by growth in mining and AI computing.
